## Brand Identity & Overview
* **Legal / Brand Name**: Bambal Infrastructure (incorporating SK Group of Architects, SK Interiors International, and Shekhar Constructions)
* **Headquarters**: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
* **Primary Specializations**:
  1. **Architecture & Master Planning**: SK Group of Architects (450+ completed designs, luxury villas, low-cost/affordable housing, institutional, commercial, resorts)
  2. **Bespoke & Budget Interior Design**: SK Interiors International (42+ completed luxury and smart-budget interior turnkey executions)
  3. **Town Planning, UDCPR & Sanctions**: High-expertise FSI/TDR maximization, NMC & NMRDA building plan approvals, MahaRERA registrations
  4. **Turnkey Civil Execution & Property Development**: Shekhar Constructions & Bambal Infrastructure (1,000+ completed projects, 206+ independent bungalows)
* **Founding Year**: 1998 (28+ years of architectural and engineering leadership in Vidarbha, Maharashtra)

## Architectural & Interior Design Leadership
* **Ar. Siddharth Bambal**: Principal Architect & Managing Partner. Alumnus of Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT Nagpur). Extensive global architectural research and practice across 70+ countries worldwide. Specialist in UDCPR FSI maximization, luxury bioclimatic bungalow architecture, high-efficiency affordable spatial layouts, and contemporary parametric facades.
* **Ar. Kanchan Bambal**: Co-Founder & Principal Architect, SK Group of Architects. Over two decades of architectural leadership in Central India. Active leader in CREDAI Maharashtra Women's Wing. Specialist in scientific Vastu Shastra planning, residential apartment schemes, and institutional master planning.
* **Chandrashekhar Bambal**: Managing Director & Civil Engineering Veteran. 28+ years of hands-on structural delivery, ensuring every architectural drawing is practically, economically, and durably built on site.

---

## Architecture Services Spectrum (SK Group of Architects)

### 1. Luxury Residential Architecture & Signature Villas
* Custom luxury bungalow design, private villas, penthouses, and farmhouses.
* Double-height living spaces, internal courtyards, infinity pool integration, cantilevered decks, private lift shafts, and landscape-integrated biophilic architecture.
* 100% scientific Vastu Shastra compliance optimized for Nagpur's hot-semi-arid solar climate.

### 2. Affordable & Low-Cost Housing Architecture (Value-Engineered)
* Space-optimized 1BHK, 2BHK, and 3BHK compact housing schemes with zero corridor wastage.
* Structural cost-optimization: grid symmetry, load-bearing vs RCC frame optimization, fly-ash/AAC blockwork, and cost-effective construction methodologies.
* PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana) compliant layouts and affordable group housing.

### 3. UDCPR, FSI & Municipal Sanction Expertise (NMC & NMRDA)
* Deep authority in Maharashtra's **UDCPR (Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations)**.
* **FSI Maximization**: Expert calculation and consumption of Basic FSI, Premium FSI, TDR (Transferable Development Rights), and Ancillary FSI (60% residential / 80% commercial).
* **Transit-Oriented Development (TOD)**: Maximizing FSI along the Nagpur Metro Rail Corridor and 24m+ arterial roads.
* **Sanctions & Approvals**: Building plan permissions from Nagpur Municipal Corporation (NMC), Nagpur Metropolitan Region Development Authority (NMRDA), and Nagpur Improvement Trust (NIT).
* **Clearances**: Release Letter (RL), Gunthewari regularizations, Non-Agricultural (NA) land conversion, Fire Department NOC, Airport Authority NOC, and MahaRERA certifications.

### 4. 3D Elevation, BIM & Photorealistic Walkthroughs
* Cinematic 3D exterior elevations, evening lighting renders, sectional isometric 3D floor plans, and interactive virtual walkthroughs.
* Millimeter-precise 1:20 architectural working construction drawings, structural vetting, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) coordination.

### 5. Commercial, Healthcare, Institutional & Hospitality
* Hospitals, specialty clinics, CBSE schools, management colleges, corporate office complexes, shopping complexes, and eco-resort master layouts.

---

## Interior Design Services Spectrum (SK Interiors International)

### 1. Ultra-Luxury Turnkey Interiors
* Bespoke custom interiors for luxury villas, floor apartments, and executive corporate suites.
* Italian marble flooring, bookmatched Statuario/Bottochino walls, fluted charcoal panels, CNC brass inlays, and customized veneer millwork.
* Imported German hardware (Blum, Hafele, Hettich) with lifetime performance warranties.
* Acoustic false ceiling architecture with concealed shadow channels and magnetic track lighting.

### 2. Smart Budget & Economical Interior Packages
* Modern, elegant turnkey interior packages for 2BHK and 3BHK flats designed for young families and investors.
* Modular BWR-grade plywood kitchens, anti-scratch acrylic/laminate finishes, and modular wardrobe systems maximizing storage per square foot.
* Cost-effective ambient 3000K lighting design delivering high-end aesthetics without luxury markups.

### 3. Commercial & Corporate Workspace Interiors
* High-productivity modern office interiors, ergonomic workstations, acoustic conference rooms, and reception focal walls for IT firms, doctors, and legal professionals.
